title: Hackmatack Farm and Playhouse

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The Hackmatack property is a wonderful place to host your next private event. From weddings to work conferences, baby showers to birthdays, our versatile indoor and outdoor space allows for a large range of possibilities for your event. Weddings at Hackmatack are an especially memorable and cherished time. Charming and historic, a ceremony in the rustic barn or nestled among one of our many hilly fields can be a serene setting for your special day. Our picturesque barns coupled with our gently rolling hills provide a breathtaking background as our bison graze peacefully in the pasture. You may choose to have a reception inside a rustic 1800s-era barn with exposed wooden beams, under a tent

services.name: Beaver Dam Campground
services.desc: Located across from Hackmatack Playhouse, Beaver Dam boasts scenic and peaceful camping spots situated among the Beaver Dam Heath, a unique natural site that is home to two rare turtle species, three rare plant species, and home to Maine’s largest Atlantic White Cedar
